    • strict

      public FlatFileItemReaderBuilder.DelimitedBuilder<T> strict(boolean strict)
      If true (the default) then the number of tokens in line must match the number of tokens defined (by Range, columns, etc.) in LineTokenizer. If false then lines with less tokens will be tolerated and padded with empty columns, and lines with more tokens will simply be truncated.
      参数:
      strict - the strict flag to set
      从以下版本开始:
      5.1
